justification: WO-2 (overlays) + WO-3 (controls) fail-closed — the two sites left tracked by the failsoft lint after S1 (#593). A FAILED overlay fetch rendered the overlay list + coverage at AUTHORITATIVE (and flood/bushfire confidently False), and a FAILED portal-controls fetch rendered zone/height/FSR blank@AUTHORITATIVE — both confident false-negatives. Used _unwrap_or_default to thread overlays_failed/controls_failed into _build_environmental and _build_planning_controls. Precise scope: purely overlay-derived fields (overlays, overlay_coverage) -> NOT_AVAILABLE on overlays_failed; flood_epi + bushfire_designation combine overlays WITH portal controls so only downgrade when BOTH failed (a surviving source still gives a real answer); mine/contaminated/drinking/heritage come from separate fetches and are untouched; biodiversity/riparian/wetlands self-heal via their existing live-query fallback. lot_dimensions stays AUTHORITATIVE under a controls failure (it comes from geometry, not controls). The failsoft lint now reports 0 tracked todos.

pre_impl.existing_data: _build_environmental stamps overlay-derived fields with a shared `auth`; flood_epi/bushfire combine overlay_list with controls; mine/contaminated/drinking/heritage/anef use separate raws. _build_planning_controls stamps all portal fields with `auth`; lot_dimensions uses geometry/area.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The audit implied mine/contaminated were overlay-derived false-negatives; in fact they are separate fetches. flood_epi/bushfire are dual-source, so a blanket overlay-failure downgrade would wrongly blank a valid portal answer.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Reused _unwrap_or_default (S1) + the existing confidence-stamping; added overlays_failed/controls_failed params and precise auth variants (overlay_auth, both_failed).
pre_impl.external_source_error: A failed PostGIS overlay or portal-controls fetch now surfaces NOT_AVAILABLE on the affected fields, never a confident 'no hazard'/blank.
pre_impl.frontend_type: Backend only; the frontend already renders NOT_AVAILABLE via describeUnavailable. 174 brief tests pass.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: Before: a failed overlay fetch -> confident overlay list/coverage + (if controls also failed) confident 'no flood'; a failed controls fetch -> blank zone/height/FSR read as authoritative. After: those surface NOT_AVAILABLE; a surviving source still answers; geometry-derived lot dimensions are unaffected.

functions.name: _build_environmental
functions.input: controls, overlays_data, heritage, the separate raws, lat/lng, and overlays_failed/controls_failed flags
functions.output: overlay list/coverage NOT_AVAILABLE when the overlay fetch failed; flood_epi/bushfire NOT_AVAILABLE only when both the overlay and the portal-controls fetch failed
functions.if_none: with both flags False it behaves exactly as before (AUTHORITATIVE)

functions.name: _build_planning_controls
functions.input: controls, overlays_data, lot geometry/area, and a controls_failed flag
functions.output: the portal-derived fields (zone/height/FSR/etc) NOT_AVAILABLE when the controls fetch failed, while geometry-derived lot_dimensions stays AUTHORITATIVE
functions.if_none: with controls_failed False it behaves exactly as before

values: N/A - confidence stamping, not regulatory values.

break_it.scenario: Overlay fetch fails but portal controls succeed and report flood-planning
break_it.what_happens: flood_epi must keep the real portal answer, not become NOT_AVAILABLE
break_it.repro: overlays_failed True, controls_failed False, controls.flood_epi truthy
break_it.how: flood_epi only downgrades when both_failed; a surviving controls source keeps AUTHORITATIVE. Guarded by test_flood_epi_survives_when_only_overlays_fail

break_it.scenario: Both overlay and controls fetches fail
break_it.what_happens: flood_epi must be NOT_AVAILABLE, never a confident False 'no flood'
break_it.how: both_failed -> value None + NOT_AVAILABLE. Guarded by test_flood_epi_not_available_when_both_sources_fail

break_it.scenario: A controls failure wrongly blanks lot dimensions that came from geometry
break_it.what_happens: lot_dimensions should stay AUTHORITATIVE when the polygon/area is present
break_it.repro: controls_failed True with a valid lot_area_m2
break_it.how: lot_dimensions uses AUTHORITATIVE independent of the controls auth. Guarded by test_controls_failed_does_not_downgrade_lot_dimensions

break_it.scenario: A genuine successful run is wrongly downgraded
break_it.what_happens: all fields must stay AUTHORITATIVE when nothing failed
break_it.how: the auth variants reduce to AUTHORITATIVE when no flag is set. Guarded by test_environmental_genuine_success_is_authoritative + test_controls_success_stays_authoritative
